source: SBP 2026 · Paper 2 · Part 2 Q2 · Essay, 125–150 words
paragraphs: Sports have the power to unite people from all walks of life. A sport that I enjoy watching is badminton. I never miss a match featuring our national players, and I often find myself cheering loudly in front of the television.

Badminton is popular in Malaysia because of our proud sporting history. Legends such as Datuk Lee Chong Wei have brought glory to the nation on the world stage. Furthermore, the sport is fast-paced and thrilling to watch. Every smash and rally keeps fans on the edge of their seats.

In my opinion, watching sports can certainly inspire people to be active. After watching a nail-biting final, many youngsters rush to the court to practise their own skills. Moreover, athletes serve as role models of discipline and perseverance. Their dedication motivates us to lead healthier lives.
